user.title: User
user.description: Represents a user in the system.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

id.description: The unique ID of the room.

hostId.description: The UID of the user who created the room.

status.description: The current status of the room.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the room was created.

currentPlayerId.description: The UID of the player whose turn it is.

turnOrder.description: An array of player UIDs in the order of their turns.

playerCount.description: The number of players for the game (1, 2, or 4).

player.title: Player
player.description: Represents a player within a room.

isDraftingDone.description: Indicates if the player has confirmed they are done drafting.

draftPick.title: Draft Pick
draftPick.description: Represents a character drafted by a player for a specific role.

vote.title: Vote
vote.description: Represents a vote cast by one player for another player's crew.

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerId}.description: Sub-collection of players in a room.

/rooms/{roomId}/draftPicks/{draftPickId}.description: Sub-collection for drafted characters by players in a room.

/rooms/{roomId}/votes/{voteId}.description: Sub-collection for votes cast by players.
